title: Restore immutable event compatibility
objective: Fence the trusted validator to exact audited first-write provenance for known malformed immutable events without rewriting historical bytes, while keeping all newly emitted events strict and preserving byte-for-byte transition immutability.
acceptance: known malformed historical events are admitted only at exact audited relative paths with exact audited first-write Git blob identities
strict-valid normalization, byte mutation, path move, cloned historical eventId, duplicate eventId, and fresh backdated legacy events fail closed
the exact audited WorldEntity and MaterialDNA first-write bytes remain representable without mutation
all unlisted events remain subject to the strict V2 schema and malformed affects do not generalize beyond exact audited first-write bytes
